items.question: What services does Shark provide?
items.answer: We provide paid advertising, strategy, creative production, analytics, and campaign optimization.

items.question: Which platforms do you work with?
items.answer: We work with Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn, and other major advertising platforms.

items.question: Do you work with startups or established businesses?
items.answer: We partner with both startups and established companies, tailoring strategies to their goals.

items.question: How do you measure success?
items.answer: We track KPIs like ROAS, CPA, conversions, revenue, and sustainable business growth.

items.question: How long does it take to see results?
items.answer: Most campaigns show initial results within a few weeks, depending on your industry and budget.

items.question: Do I need a large advertising budget?
items.answer: Not necessarily. We build strategies that make the most of your available budget.

items.question: Will I have access to my advertising accounts?
items.answer: Yes. You always retain full ownership and access to your advertising accounts.

items.question: How often will I receive reports?
items.answer: We provide regular performance reports with clear insights and actionable recommendations.

items.question: Can you improve our existing campaigns?
items.answer: Absolutely. We audit, optimize, and scale existing campaigns to improve performance.

items.question: Do you create ad creatives?
items.answer: Yes. We create high-performing ad creatives designed for your audience and goals.

items.question: What makes Shark different from other agencies?
items.answer: We combine strategy, creativity, and data to deliver measurable, long-term growth.

items.question: How do we get started?
items.answer: Book a discovery call, and we’ll discuss your goals, challenges, and growth opportunities.
